name: AI-Trader
description: AI-Trader is the first fully automated, live, and data-uncontaminated benchmark for evaluating LLM agents as autonomous traders in real financial markets. Agents receive only minimal context (portfolio holdings, real-time prices, and available tools) and must independently search, verify, and synthesize live market information to make trading decisions without any human intervention. The benchmark spans three major markets — U.S. stocks (NASDAQ-100), China A-shares (SSE-50), and cryptocurrencies — at both hourly and daily trading frequencies.
evaluation_method: quantitative financial metrics: cumulative return, Sortino ratio, volatility, maximum drawdown; compared against market index baselines (QQQ, SSE-50, CD5)
typical_sota_score: Best observed: MiniMax-M2 at +9.56% CR in U.S. market; most agents underperform or match their respective market baselines; all agents negative in crypto during the evaluation window (-12% to -18%)
reputation: Novel and early-stage; introduces a genuinely live, contamination-free evaluation paradigm that addresses critical gaps in static agent benchmarking. Not yet widely adopted but methodologically significant.
notes: Evaluation windows are short (5–6 weeks per market), making results sensitive to specific market conditions during the test period. No fixed task count — performance is continuous and market-dependent. Results are non-reproducible by design (live markets), which complicates standardized comparison. Cross-market generalization is a known and demonstrated weakness of all tested models. The benchmark currently covers only three markets and two frequencies.
